root_cause: Escape key clears the input value instead of only closing the suggestion list.
repair_strategy: Modify the navigate handler in listController.js to remove the line that clears ctx.input.value on Escape and the clear event emission, keeping only the close(ctx) call.
expected_accessibility_effect: Users can dismiss suggestions with Escape while retaining their typed input, preserving keyboard operability and preventing loss of entered text.
functional_risks: Potential loss of the 'clear' event that some consumers might rely on to reset state.
If any custom logic depends on the input being cleared on Escape, it may break.
verification_requirements: After typing a value and pressing Escape, the input value must remain unchanged and the suggestion list must be closed.
Focus must return to the input element.
Form data must reflect the typed value.
Existing keyboard interactions (Enter, Tab, Arrow keys) must continue to work as before.
